alex_newhire: hey folks, day 2 onboarding snag. ssh to bastion works but i can't reach internal confluence at 10.11.12.5:80 from my laptop. browser just times out. anyone seen this when working from home? :wave:

wg-bot: WireGuard peer=alex_newhire, latest_handshake=15s ago, endpoint=198.51.100.77:51820

anna-eng: welcome! first check: does `dig confluence.internal.redwood @10.10.0.2` resolve to 10.11.12.5 and what's your default `dig` returning? also paste `ip route` if you can.

alex_newhire: dig to 10.10.0.2 -> 10.11.12.5, default dig -> 203.0.113.21. ip route shows default via 192.168.0.1, wg0 present but no 10.11.0.0/16 route.

marco-sre: sounds like split-DNS + route priority issue. your machine resolves to the public IP so traffic doesn't go over wg0. short-term: SSH tunnel to bastion. `ssh -L 8080:10.11.12.5:80 alex@bastion.redwood.internal -N` then open http://localhost:8080.

alex_newhire: tried the ssh -L and it works, can load confluence now. thanks!! :tada:

anna-eng: for interactive browsing we prefer a SOCKS proxy: `ssh -D 1080 alex@bastion.redwood.internal -N` then set browser to socks5h://localhost:1080. avoids per-service tunnels.

alex_newhire: will try that next. why is wg0 not routing the internal subnet though? wg show shows allowedips includes 10.11.0.0/16.

marco-sre: sometimes the OS doesn't add routes for allowedips (esp on some Linux distros or when using NetworkManager). quick fix: `sudo ip route add 10.11.0.0/16 dev wg0` or restart the wireguard service. we'll add an onboarding script to auto-install routes.

sarah-security: small policy note: do not request adding home ISP ranges to egress allowlists. tunneling via bastion or a proxy is the approved onboarding workaround. if you need longer-term access, file a request with justification.

anna-eng: FYI carrier-grade NAT can also break outbound allowlist rules for some home ISPs. if you see traceroute hitting 100.64.0.1 that's CGNAT. in those cases the bastion tunnel avoids the SNAT problem.

alex_newhire: ran traceroute earlier and saw 100.64.0.1 indeed. good to know.

marco-sre: small tip: if you get flaky WireGuard handshakes or weird fragmentation with mesh routers, lower MTU on wg0: `sudo ip link set dev wg0 mtu 1280` and restart. helped a few hires.

alex_newhire: can someone add the ssh -D/-L recipes and the MTU workaround to the new-hires doc? this saved my morning. :)

infra-bot: created NET-854: "onboarding: split-dns + ssh-proxy snippets for new hires" (created by marco-sre).
